memory_bridge: Under the person-roof, hold a card for 今回 with On コン, then tear away the card and point to the present instant 今 with Kun いま.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 今回（こんかい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Hang 今回（こんかい）, “this time,” from the roof like an event card; the first character begins with On コン.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 今（いま）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Drop the event card, clap at the immediate moment, and say 今（いま）; the standalone native word fixes Kun いま, “now.”
